main_finding: Most original popularity-conditional bias already exists in separate WIN/TOP3 forecasts. Joint conversion trades off marginal accuracy; it is not the sole source.

selection_rule: Choose lowest-complexity method whose pooled 2025 forward-validation ordered-top3 mean logloss is within one standard error of the best mean; tie-break lower mean then name. Standard error computed over validation races. The prior shared_ai_market method is a prespecified incumbent.
